title: OVERNIGHT_SUMMARY_2026-06-22
universal_lens: The system enforces a strict hierarchical decoupling of information layers. By isolating raw predictive outputs from underlying generative reasoning, the architecture establishes an isomorphism between cryptographic access control and epistemic transparency, ensuring that public observables remain mathematically calibrated while preserving proprietary state-space dynamics.
gsi_mapping: Calibrated confidence acts as a conformal prediction set boundary. The isotonic calibrator minimizes Expected Calibration Error (ECE), transforming raw model logits into honest win probabilities. This ensures free-tier users receive statistically valid marginal distributions without exposing the high-dimensional feature space reserved for Pro tiers.
gse_mapping: Branch-only deployment functions as a discrete state-transition gate in the product automaton. Decoupling `canSeePremiumPicks` from analytics APIs prevents unauthorized transitions into higher-value state spaces. The system dynamically routes user queries based on tiered boolean flags, maintaining situational integrity across varying permission levels.

primitives.name: Reasoning vs Confidence Partition

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C: Calibrated confidence scalar; R: Reasoning vector (high-dimensional text/embedding); U: User tier.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the marginal probability C contains sufficient utility for basic decision-making without requiring the full joint distribution explanation R.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks if downstream UI components attempt to render R by default when C is present, violating the partition boundary.

reasoning_traces.think:
The overnight autonomous run executes a precise topological surgery on the application's permission graph. Initially, the system suffered from an overloaded authorization primitive (`canSeePremiumPicks`), which acted as a monolithic switch simultaneously governing public pick visibility and high-value analytics API access. This collinearity created a severe security vulnerability: any business logic attempting to democratize the former would inevitably leak the latter. The deployed operator performs a strict decoupling, effectively projecting the monolithic boolean onto two orthogonal axes: pick visibility and tool access. Concurrently, the system addresses a profound epistemic flaw—raw model confidence is inherently over-dispersed and optimistically biased. To rectify this, an isotonic calibration kernel is introduced. This kernel operates as a post-hoc adjustment layer, mapping raw logits to empirically grounded win probabilities using a held-out validation set. The dramatic reduction in Expected Calibration Error (from 0.198 to 0.044) signifies a transition from naive heuristics to rigorous conformal inference. Crucially, this calibration is gated by a self-suppressing mechanism requiring a minimum threshold of settled events (N ≥ 100), preventing the system from applying spurious corrections to sparse data regimes. Finally, the architecture partitions the output manifold: the calibrated scalar (confidence) is liberated for the free tier, while the high-dimensional explanatory vector (reasoning) remains securely locked behind the Pro paywall. This tripartite transformation—topological decoupling, statistical calibration, and informational partitioning—ensures the platform maintains commercial viability while drastically improving the mathematical honesty of its public-facing predictions.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architectural evolution mirrors the historical progression of probabilistic forecasting systems, moving from opaque, black-box heuristic outputs toward transparent, statistically validated conformal predictors. It echoes the foundational shifts in machine learning operations where raw model scores were historically exposed, leading to widespread miscalibration. The explicit decoupling of access controls reflects modern zero-trust security paradigms applied to information economics, ensuring that increasing surface area for user engagement does not proportionally increase the risk of intellectual property leakage or privilege escalation.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models two distinct classes of agents: the casual observer seeking actionable, trustworthy signals, and the professional analyst requiring deep, mechanistic insights. For the casual observer, the primary cognitive barrier is distrust in inflated model confidence; the isotonic calibrator directly addresses this by providing 'honest' probabilities, thereby building epistemic trust. For the professional, the value proposition shifts entirely to the 'why'—the underlying feature attribution and strategic reasoning. By partitioning these outputs, the architecture respects the differing information needs of each agent class, preventing the casual user from being overwhelmed by complexity while ensuring the professional retains exclusive access to the generative logic.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical anti-collinearity veto is enforced at the routing layer to prevent silent privilege escalation. The decoupling of `canSeePremiumPicks` from the analytics API (`/api/intelligence/*`) acts as a hard boundary condition. If the frontend attempts to fetch reasoning vectors while only possessing pick visibility rights, the backend must strictly reject the query. Furthermore, the calibration kernel includes a temporal veto: it refuses to activate unless the historical settlement buffer exceeds 100 events. This prevents the system from emitting artificially smoothed probabilities during cold-start phases, ensuring that the public-facing confidence metrics never violate the established error bounds under low-data regimes.
